title: Virgin Galactic wants your help naming its new Delta class spaceship
summary: Delta-class ships may fly as many as eight space missions per month, 12 times what was possible with SpaceShipTwo, according to Virgin Galactic. Virgin Galactic returned to flight—and reached space for the first time—on its second SpaceShipTwo, named Unity .
